legal.privacyIntro: LastTouch is a marketplace that connects clients with beauty and grooming businesses. This policy explains what we collect and why, in plain words.
legal.privacyS1B: Your account details (name, phone, email, gender, age, profile photo), your bookings and history, saved stores, and payment references (card brand, last 4 digits and expiry only — your full card number never reaches our servers). Stores see only the booking details you share with them.
legal.privacyS2B: To run your bookings, show your history, personalize the marketplace (such as sorting by your preferences), and keep your account secure. We never sell your personal data.
legal.privacyS3B: We share booking details with the store you book at so they can serve you. Service providers who help us run the app (hosting, login, file storage) only process data on our instructions.
legal.privacyS4B: You can edit your info anytime from your account page, and you can permanently delete your account — deleting removes your profile, saved stores and payment references, and unlinks your bookings.
legal.privacyS5B: Nearby stores use your location only when you tap Near me, and only inside your browser to sort stores by distance. Your location is never uploaded or stored.
legal.termsIntro: By creating an account or booking through LastTouch, you agree to these terms.
legal.termsS1B: One account per person. Your phone number and email must belong to you and may each be used by a single account. You are responsible for activity under your account.
legal.termsS2B: A booking is a request until the store confirms it. Cancel in good time from your bookings page if you cannot make it; repeated no-shows may limit your account. Stores set their own prices, services and working hours.
legal.termsS3B: Saved cards are references for faster checkout only. Any online charge is processed by the store or its payment provider under their own terms.
legal.termsS4B: Do not misuse the platform — no fake bookings, no scraping, no content that breaks the law. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
legal.termsS5B: We may update these terms as the product evolves; continued use after changes take effect means you accept them.
